review.authorityBasis: ADR-0058 requires stopping authoritative execution when discovered tests are unsealed; ADR-0034 remains historical authority context.

environmentPrerequisites: Unit tests need the repository Node 20+ workspace, built @kshiai/shared, and isolated SQLite/temp directories where applicable.

Workflow and script tests read repository files; deployment smoke, Cloudflare, R2, release, and rollback tests require the exact mocked or explicitly supplied target configuration and must not be treated as live acceptance.

persistent-battle-e2e and its observation workflow can contact configured production Cloud Run/Postgres/Supabase and invoke provider work; a paid/provider budget, exact revision, run identity, max retries, and owner approval are prerequisites.

stage-auth-smoke and supabase-auth-smoke use local fixtures in these tests, but the corresponding executable scripts can use Supabase and provider credentials; keep test mode/local endpoint binding explicit.

e2e tests require Playwright plus a Chromium executable; v3-local-integration explicitly uses local servers and MockLlmProvider, while character-focused/history/battle-screen use intercepted browser routes.
historicalConflict: prepare-unreleased-v3-trial, verify-v3-trial-evidence, semantic-migration-probe, and persistent workflow material retain historical VT103/VT104 trial language. ADR-0042 accepts an unreleased first V3 trial boundary, but that does not make a retired trial receipt or a current production acceptance; each needs a current owner-selected run and exact revision before resealing.
